caption: The drawing depicts a doorway with two doors, one on the left and one on the right. The door on the left is wooden with a natural brown color, featuring a pattern of rectangular panels. The door on the right is composed of three square panels, each decorated with a star-shaped floral design. The main frame of this door is painted green, while the panels inside the frame are a muted reddish-pink color with decorative yellow details. Both doors are open, revealing a plain, softly colored blue-gray interior wall and a small portion of the brown tiled floor visible at the bottom. The doors are mounted within a simple light brown frame, and the right-hand green door is attached with visible metallic hinges. The drawing is centered on a white or cream-colored background, and the artist's signature "EDWARD J. LEMOTT" appears near the lower right of the image.
title: Doors
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
